text: 今天（5日），财政部第三次续发行2026年超长期特别国债（四期）。本次续发行国债为30年期固定利率附息债，总额730亿元，票面利率与之前发行的同期国债相同，为2.23%。（央视新闻）
text_en: Today (5th), the Ministry of Finance conducted the third additional issuance of the 2026 ultra-long special treasury bonds (Tranche IV). This issuance is a 30-year fixed-rate bond with a total amount of RMB 73 billion, carrying the same coupon rate of 2.23% as previous issuances of the same tenor. (CCTV News)
